title: Console state model and spec harness
description:
Implement ConsoleState, ConsoleIssue, ConsoleSettings, and ConsoleComment models in Swift (matching the Python/Rust patterns), implement issue visibility filtering (type tabs: Initiatives, Epics, Tasks, All), wire @console-tagged feature files to Swift step definitions, and prove the model passes the basic kanban board scenarios.

Spec coverage target: features/console/kanban_board.feature (1 file, proof of concept).
